result.question: What does the man of God cry at Bethel?

readings.answer: He cries against the altar that a son named Josiah from David’s house will come and sacrifice the high-place priests on it, and human bones will be burned on it.
readings.support: A son named Josiah will be born to the house of David | he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense upon you, and human bones will be burned upon you

readings.answer: He cries out against the altar.
readings.support: he cried out against the altar
